description: Output file suffix. All output files will be prefixed with this label. Corresponds to the output directory OUT.suffix.
name: suffix

description: Number of atom types. Must match the number of species blocks in the STRU file.
name: ntype

description: Type of calculation to perform. 'scf': self-consistent field ground state. 'relax': ionic relaxation (BFGS). 'cell-relax': cell + ionic relaxation. 'md': molecular dynamics. 'nscf': non-self-consistent field (for band structures, DOS). 'get_S': compute overlap matrix only.
name: calculation

description: Plane-wave kinetic energy cutoff in Ry. Controls the completeness of the PW basis. Typical values for norm-conserving pseudopotentials: 50-100 Ry. For LCAO calculations this sets the PW auxiliary basis cutoff.
name: ecutwfc

description: Type of basis set. 'pw': plane-wave basis only. 'lcao': linear combination of atomic orbitals (requires orbital files). 'lcao_in_pw': LCAO in PW projection.
name: basis_type

description: Directory containing pseudopotential files (UPF format). If a relative path is given it is resolved relative to the working directory.
name: pseudo_dir

description: Directory containing numerical atomic orbital files (.orb format). Required when basis_type=lcao.
name: orbital_dir

description: Symmetry analysis switch. 1: auto-detect crystal symmetry and use it to reduce k-points. 0: no symmetry analysis (use full k-mesh). -1: use time-reversal symmetry only.
name: symmetry

description: Number of spin channels. 1: non-spin-polarized. 2: spin-polarized (collinear). 4: non-collinear spin-orbit coupling.
name: nspin

description: Number of Kohn-Sham bands to compute. If not set, ABACUS auto-selects nbands = max(nelec/2 + 4, nelec*1.2). For band-structure (nscf) calculations set this explicitly to include empty bands above the Fermi level.
name: nbands

description: Exchange-correlation functional. 'default': use functional embedded in pseudopotential. 'lda': LDA (PZ). 'pbe': PBE (GGA). 'pbesol': PBEsol. 'hse': HSE06 (hybrid). 'scan': SCAN meta-GGA. 'pbe0': PBE0 (hybrid). 'revpbe': revPBE. 'vdwd3': PBE+D3 dispersion.
name: dft_functional

description: Convergence threshold for the SCF density difference (||rho_new - rho_old||). Typical value: 1e-7 for single-point; tighten to 1e-8 for force/stress calculations.
name: scf_thr

description: Maximum number of SCF iterations. If convergence is not reached within scf_nmax steps the job terminates (for 'scf') or continues with the next ionic step (for 'relax').
name: scf_nmax

description: Density mixing scheme for SCF convergence. 'plain': simple linear mixing. 'pulay': Pulay DIIS mixing. 'broyden': Broyden mixing (recommended for most systems). 'broyden-modified': modified Broyden.
name: mixing_type

description: Mixing coefficient (linear mixing factor). Range 0–1; smaller values give more stable but slower convergence. Typical: 0.4-0.8 for metals, 0.1-0.4 for difficult systems.
name: mixing_beta

description: Number of previous charge densities kept in the Broyden/Pulay mixing history. Larger values generally improve convergence stability at the cost of memory.
name: mixing_ndim

description: Use Gamma-only k-point sampling. 1: Gamma only (fast, for large supercells or molecules). 0: use full k-mesh from KPT file.
name: gamma_only

description: Reciprocal-space k-point spacing in 1/Bohr. When set, ABACUS auto-generates a Monkhorst-Pack grid with this spacing. Typical: 0.1-0.2 1/Bohr for metals, 0.2-0.5 for insulators. Mutually exclusive with reading the KPT file.
name: kspacing

description: Fermi-level smearing method. 'fixed': no smearing (insulator/semiconductor). 'gauss': Gaussian smearing (metal). 'fermi-dirac': Fermi-Dirac distribution. 'methfessel-paxton': Methfessel-Paxton (metal, high accuracy). 'marzari-vanderbilt': cold smearing.
name: smearing_method

description: Smearing broadening parameter in Ry. Typical values: 0.01-0.03 Ry for metals. Should be validated by checking that total energy is converged w.r.t. smearing_sigma.
name: smearing_sigma

description: Force convergence threshold in Ry/Bohr for ionic relaxation. The relaxation stops when the maximum force on any atom falls below this value. Typical: 1e-3 for rough, 1e-4 for tight.
name: force_thr

description: Stress convergence threshold in kbar for cell-relaxation. The optimization stops when all stress tensor components are below this value.
name: stress_thr

description: Maximum number of ionic relaxation steps. If convergence is not reached the calculation stops with a warning.
name: relax_nmax

description: Algorithm for ionic relaxation. 'bfgs': quasi-Newton BFGS (recommended). 'cg': conjugate gradient. 'sd': steepest descent (slow). 'fire': FIRE algorithm (good for large systems).
name: relax_method

description: Whether to compute atomic forces. 0: no. 1: yes (automatically enabled for 'relax' and 'md' calculations). Required for ionic optimization.
name: cal_force

description: Whether to compute the stress tensor. 0: no. 1: yes (required for 'cell-relax' calculations and EOS calculations).
name: cal_stress

description: Output charge density to file. 0: no output. 1: write charge density (SPIN1_CHG.cube). Useful for visualisation or as restart checkpoint.
name: out_chg

description: Output density of states. 0: no. 1: write DOS files (requires NSCF or post-SCF calculation with sufficient k-points). Output files: TDOS.dat, LDOS.dat.
name: out_dos

description: Output band structure along k-path. 0: no. 1: write BANDS_1.dat (requires 'nscf' calculation with K_POINTS BAND block in KPT file).
name: out_band

description: Output projected band structure (fat bands). 0: no. 1: yes (requires basis_type=lcao).
name: out_proj_band

description: Output updated STRU file after relaxation. 0: no. 1: write STRU_ION_D (each ionic step) and STRU_NOW (final structure).
name: out_stru

description: Output LCAO wavefunction coefficients. 0: no. 1: write wavefunction coefficients to WFC_NAO_GAMMA.dat (or WFC_NAO_K*.dat for multiple k-points). Requires basis_type=lcao.
name: out_wfc_lcao

description: Gaussian broadening width (eV) for DOS calculation. Controls the energy resolution of the output DOS curve. Smaller values give sharper features but require more k-points.
name: dos_sigma

description: Minimum energy (eV, relative to Fermi level) for DOS output window. Defaults to auto-detect from band structure.
name: dos_emin_ev

description: Maximum energy (eV, relative to Fermi level) for DOS output window. Defaults to auto-detect from band structure.
name: dos_emax_ev

description: Energy step (eV) for DOS grid. Smaller values give finer energy resolution in the output DOS curve.
name: dos_edelta_ev

description: Molecular dynamics ensemble / thermostat. 'nvt': NVT with velocity rescaling (Berendsen). 'npt': NPT (Parrinello-Rahman). 'nve': NVE micro-canonical. 'msst': multi-shock Hugoniot. 'fire': FIRE relaxation via MD.
name: md_type

description: Number of MD time steps to run.
name: md_nstep

description: MD time step in fs. Typical values: 0.5-2 fs for atomic systems. Smaller steps improve energy conservation at the cost of computational time.
name: md_dt

description: Initial temperature for MD in K. Used to generate initial Maxwell-Boltzmann velocities.
name: md_tfirst

description: Final temperature for MD in K. If set, a linear temperature ramp is applied from md_tfirst to md_tlast over the run.
name: md_tlast

description: Thermostat frequency (1/fs) for Berendsen NVT thermostat. Determines how tightly the temperature is controlled. Typical: 1/40 to 1/10.
name: md_tfreq

description: Frequency (in MD steps) for writing trajectory frames to MD_dump file.
name: md_dumpfreq

description: Frequency (in MD steps) for writing restart files (Restart_md.dat). Allows resuming interrupted MD runs.
name: md_restartfreq

description: Van der Waals dispersion correction method. 'none': no dispersion. 'd2': Grimme D2. 'd3_0': Grimme D3 with zero damping. 'd3_bj': Grimme D3 with Becke-Johnson damping (recommended).
name: vdw_method

description: D3 overall scaling factor s6. For PBE+D3 this should be 1.0 (the default). Usually not changed.
name: vdw_s6

description: Output DeePKS machine-learning labels (eigenvalues, forces) for training. 1: write labels. Requires DeePKS support compiled in.
name: deepks_out_labels

description: Use DeePKS model in SCF loop for corrected DFT+ML energy. 1: enabled. Requires a trained DeePKS model file.
name: deepks_scf

description: Initial charge density. 'atomic': superposition of free-atom densities (default, safe choice). 'file': read from SPIN1_CHG.cube (restart). 'auto': attempt file first, fall back to atomic.
name: init_chg

description: Read initial atomic velocities from STRU file. 0: use Maxwell-Boltzmann at md_tfirst. 1: read velocities from STRU (requires VELOCITY block).
name: init_vel

description: Enable non-collinear spin calculation. 0: collinear. 1: non-collinear (requires nspin=4). Non-collinear mode enables spin-orbit coupling.
name: noncolin

description: Enable spin-orbit coupling (SOC). 0: off. 1: on. Requires noncolin=1 and nspin=4. Needs fully-relativistic pseudopotentials.
name: lspinorb

description: Dipole correction for slab calculations. 0: off. 1: apply dipole correction along the axis specified by dip_cor_axis. Needed for asymmetric slabs.
name: dip_cor_flag

description: Axis along which to apply dipole correction ('x', 'y', or 'z'). Only used when dip_cor_flag=1.
name: dip_cor_axis

description: Apply external electric field. 0: off. 1: on. The field direction and amplitude are set by efield_dir and efield_amp.
name: efield_flag

description: Direction of the external electric field (0=x, 1=y, 2=z). Only used when efield_flag=1.
name: efield_dir

description: Amplitude of the external electric field in a.u. (1 a.u. ≈ 51.4 V/Å).
name: efield_amp

description: Enable DFT+U Hubbard correction. 0: off. 1: on (Dudarev simplified rotationally invariant). Requires orbital_corr and hubbard_u to be set in the STRU file or INPUT.
name: lda_plus_u

description: Hubbard U parameters (in eV) for each atom type, space-separated. Must have ntype entries. Example: hubbard_u 4.5 0.0 (for a two-species system where only the first has U applied).
name: hubbard_u

description: Angular momentum quantum number l of the correlated orbital for each atom type. -1: no correction, 0: s, 1: p, 2: d, 3: f. Must have ntype entries. Example: orbital_corr 2 -1.
name: orbital_corr

description: Fixed magnetization (number of up-minus-down electrons) for spin-polarized calculations. Only used when nspin=2.
name: nupdown

description: Frequency (steps) for printing MD energy to running_md.log. Smaller values generate more detailed output.
name: printe

description: Kohn-Sham equation diagonalization method. 'default': auto-select based on basis_type. 'cg': conjugate-gradient (good for PW). 'dav': Davidson iterative diagonalizer. 'genelpa': generalized eigenvalue via ELPA (recommended for large LCAO).
name: ks_solver

description: Convergence threshold for the iterative diagonalization of the KS Hamiltonian. This is tightened automatically as SCF converges.
name: pw_diag_thr

description: Maximum number of iterations for the iterative diagonalization of the KS Hamiltonian per SCF step.
name: pw_diag_nmax

description: Number of k-point pools for MPI parallelisation. npool must divide evenly into the total number of MPI ranks. Set to the number of k-points for best performance.
name: npool

description: Number of occupied bands above VBM to include in TDDFT calculations. Only relevant for calculation=tddft.
name: nband_istate

description: Memory-saving mode. 0: standard (fastest). 1: reduce memory usage at some computational overhead. Useful for very large systems that approach memory limits.
name: mem_saver

description: Output dipole moment (in Debye). 0: no. 1: write dipole to running_scf.log.
name: out_dipole

description: Output Mulliken population analysis. 0: no. 1: write Mulliken charges to mulliken.txt. Requires basis_type=lcao.
name: out_mul

description: Output all KS eigenvalues (including unoccupied) to file. 0: no. 1: write to KS_EIGENVALUES.dat.
name: out_allband

description: Compute macroscopic polarization via Berry phase. 0: off. 1: compute along direction gdir.
name: berry_phase

description: Reciprocal lattice direction for Berry phase calculation. 1: G1, 2: G2, 3: G3 (c-axis). Requires berry_phase=1.
name: gdir

description: Self-consistent constraining magnetic moment switch. 0: off. 1: constrain total magnetization. Requires nspin=2.
name: sc_mag_switch

description: Interface with Wannier90: write AMN/MMN/EIG files for post-processing with wannier90. 0: off. 1: on. Requires basis_type=lcao.
name: towannier90

description: Spin channel to use for Wannier90 projection. 'up': spin-up channel. 'down': spin-down channel. Only relevant when nspin=2 and towannier90=1.
name: wannier_spin

description: Path to the structure file (STRU format). Default is 'STRU' in the working directory.
name: stru_file

description: Path to the k-point sampling file (KPT format). Default is 'KPT' in the working directory. Not needed when gamma_only=1.
name: kpoint_file

description: Type of energy solver. 'ksdft': standard Kohn-Sham DFT. 'ofdft': orbital-free DFT (for simple metals at high pressure). 'sdft': stochastic DFT. 'tddft': time-dependent DFT.
name: esolver_type

description: Dimension of the Krylov subspace used in the OS (optimal damping) preconditioning. Only used for charge-mixing.
name: scf_os_ndim

description: Fix atomic positions during relaxation. 0: all atoms free. 1: freeze atoms marked with 0 0 0 in the STRU ATOMIC_POSITIONS block.
name: fixed_atoms

description: Calculate electrical conductivity via Kubo-Greenwood formula. 0: off. 1: on.
name: cal_cond
